idea: Explore the graph in rings around the start: first the start, then everything one edge away, then two edges away, using a queue. Every node is reached by the route with the fewest edges.
useWhen: You need the fewest number of edges from one node to every other
The edges are unweighted, or all weights are equal
Checking whether the graph is connected
avoidWhen: The edges have different weights and you need the lightest route (use Dijkstra)
The graph is huge and very wide: the queue grows with the widest ring
